name: Colmena
def: Swarm of five palm sized Mexican micro robots intended to self organise on the lunar regolith, lost with the Peregrine lander.
body: Colmena was developed by the space instrumentation laboratory at UNAM as Mexico's first lunar mission, with five wheeled robots about twelve centimetres across. Released from a rail on the Astrobotic Peregrine lander, they were to drive together, link into a shared electrical network and measure regolith and plasma conditions. The mission ended when Peregrine suffered a propellant leak in January 2024 and re entered the atmosphere.
facts: Five robots designed to operate as a cooperative swarm
specs: Small wheeled micro robots designed to work as a group
Regolith and plasma sensors with position tracking
Cooperative swarm behaviour rather than individual teleoperation
